title: Hardship Assistance History Clause (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
**Clause.** On an Insulin Pump Program, the program's earlier hardship waivers add points to the share of a hardship waiver: where no hardship waiver was ever posted on the program, 10 points (the full history points) are added to the share; where none was posted in the 12 months before today but an older one was, 5 points (the partial history points) are added; otherwise nothing is added.

**Records read.** The balance adjustments posted on the pump program for a hardship waiver, by posting date. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

| Earlier hardship waivers on the program | Points added |
|---|---|
| none ever | 10 |
| none in the 12 months before today; at least one before that | 5 |
| at least one in the 12 months before today | none |

*Hypothetical cases:* a program whose only earlier hardship waiver was posted 20 months ago adds 5 points; one with a hardship waiver posted 4 months ago adds none; with today 15 June, a waiver posted on 15 June of the previous year is outside the 12 months.
